title: What Is AI Sovereignty? Nvidia's Huang Says Every Nation Needs Its Own System
key_facts: South Korea's Lee Jae-myung administration is pursuing its own AI foundation model and a new chip cluster.
No country has a complete AI pyramid: the US depends on Samsung and SK hynix for advanced memory; China lacks Nvidia and AMD chips for cutting-edge models.
AMD panel (23 Jul 2026): HPE's Trish Damkroger said sovereignty means ownership of systems, data and outputs; Bull's Bruno Lecointe said 'sovereignty is likely to be something far more open'.
Another panelist said 'AI sovereignty is not isolation'.
Lecointe called China the main example of isolation, forced by US restrictions.
Huang began making the case for sovereign AI in Paris in Nov 2023.
Stanford HAI report (July): core of sovereign AI is calibrating interdependence, not eliminating dependency.
quote_evidence: The core of sovereign AI, the report concluded, is not eliminating dependency but calibrating interdependence.
why_it_matters_hint: Governments are rethinking AI independence as partnership.
